capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Estimated: EV Database Panasonic 2170L pack: 82.0 kWh nominal; evspecifications 2021 North American LR AWD: 82.1 kWh. Carried over from the 2021 Fremont-built car; NRCan/EPA list the Shanghai imports as separate "(Import)" ratings, so this non-import car is taken as Fremont. Years compared 2021 vs 2022: no pack change found.

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: Tesla's release note (2020.24.6.4, Model S/3/X/Y) says the car preconditions its battery when navigating to a fast charger; this is a software feature delivered to the whole Model 3 line (2022 LR AWD). Page mentions no manual battery-warming control. A manual control was neither found nor ruled out: Tesla's owner's manual pages were blocked (403) and scheduled-departure preconditioning in search excerpts is cabin-oriented.
